provenance: XDuck constrained motor-target search; not an official learned policy or hardware validation
shape_constraint: Knee targets monotone; hip, ankle and neck have one preparation-and-return excursion; measured reverse height travel and settling motion penalized.
acceptance_note: Continuous C2 motor targets; nominal simulator endpoint and contact acceptance only. Peak ground load below 3 bodyweights is a screening condition, not hardware certification. Faster motion supersedes the slow v2 descent speed criterion.
